Synopsis:
Dialog that triggers when the players kill one person on the target list and they aren't part of the Bhaal Cult yet. Backup dialog if players kill the first doppelganger by mistake.

Cluster Contexts:
- LOW_SerialKiller_DoppelgangerGiveQuest_Backup.json: The player has just killed one of the people on a murder target list but is not yet a member of the Bhaal Cult; this conversation branch fires after that killing. If the party accidentally dispatched the wrong body — a doppelganger in disguise — the impostor reveals itself and taunts the player, treating the killing as proof of appetite for slaughter and offering induction or greater power. Off‑screen the district is tense from recent deaths and cult activity (Father Lorgan’s death and other murders), and nearby NPCs have reacted in varied ways — some grieving or suspicious, others flippant or dismissive — so the player’s actions carry social and moral consequences. The exchange is therefore a recruitment/temptation scene: the doppelganger/accoster tests whether the player will accept becoming “more than a common murderer.”
- LOW_SerialKiller_DoppelgangerGiveQuest.json: The player has just killed one person from a known target list but has not yet joined the Bhaal Cult, and this conversation triggers as a recruiter approaches. The speaker (a doppelganger-like agent) acknowledges the murder, praises the player's aptitude for killing, and tempts them with promotion into something greater — an avatar or agent of slaughter — effectively offering cult recruitment. Off‑screen the city is tense from recent killings and deaths (other NPCs like Yannis, Valeria, tavern patrons, and grieving townsfolk have already reacted), so this offer arrives amid fear, suspicion, and rumors. The player's reply (“Tell me what I must do”) signals willingness to hear tasks or rites that would bind them closer to the cult.
- LOW_Park_BhaalAssassin04.json: One-liner for a Bhaal Cultist hiding in plain sight in the Park. Dialog should only trigger if a player manages to sneak in to the ambush area. Combat will start after this dialog plays.
- WYR_Axe_PAD_AssassinsDefeated.json: PAD after killing the doppelganger assassins in Danthelon's. Three versions can trigger:1. Player has never seen doppelgangers before2. Player has already seen doppelgangers in Wyrm's Crossing and connects them to the cult.3. Player knows that Orin is a doppelganger and connects them definitively to her / Bhaal.
- LOW_ParkCultistAmbush_001.json: The player is confronted by some Bhaalist cutlists who've just murdered a civilian in Bloomridge park. The cultists recognise the player as even greater targets - those Orin wants dead. They turn hostile, with more appearing after the dialogue, leaving the player outnumbered.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Doppelganger: Approach - unique. Form - sloppy. But the passion for killing - like a game. It's a shame I was the only acolyte here to witness you. || [context] CinematicNodeContext: The doppelganger should have a maniac smile in his face. (node 17)
- Doppelganger: Would you like to be more than a common murderer? To become an avatar of slaughter? (node 13)
- Player: Tell me what I must do. (node 6)
